card.statement:
As a last remark on the affine Grassmannian of an algebraic group we notice the following. Assume $H$ is a semisimple group over $\mathbb{C}$ and $B$ is a Borel subgroup of $H$. By construction we have a natural morphism $\mathcal{G}r_{B}\longrightarrow\mathcal{G}r_{H}$. By Iwasawa decomposition we have $H(\mathbb{C}(\!(t)\!))=B(\mathbb{C}(\!(t)\!))\cdot H(\mathbb{C}[\![t]\!])$, in particular at the level of $\mathbb{C}$ points we have $\mathcal{G}r_{B}(\mathbb{C})=\mathcal{G}r_{H}(\mathbb{C})$ however the two affine Grassmannians are very different: the first one is ind-affine, has infinitely many connected components and is not reduced, while the second one is ind-projective, reduced and connected.

1.2. Definition and statement of the main results

In this Section we study representability properties of different quotients of the double loop group $LLG$ of $G$ (or of $LJG$, the loop of the jet group $JG$ ) in the case $G$ is solvable. In particular $LLG(R)=G\big(R(\!(t)\!)(\!(s)\!)\big)$. Namely we consider different subgroups $H$ of $LLG$, and we define the quotient as the presheaf over $\mathsf{Aff}_{k}={\mathsf{CAlg}}_{k}^{\mathrm{op}}$ given by:

$\frac{LLG}{H}(R)=\frac{LLG(R)}{H(R)}.$

Below we list the quotients we are interested in. We will then prove that these presheaves are already fppf sheaves.
card.label: Remark 1.4

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
